name: Routine log
oneLiner: a glass log of scheduled jobs: rows of time, name and machine tag reveal top-down with pending dots, a lit cursor sweeps down the times and each row flips to a green FIRED check while the header counter rolls up, the last one landing with a pop
say: when the speaker says jobs run on a schedule without them ('every morning at 4am it...', 'these fire while I sleep'): cut in on the schedule, the counter lands as they say how many ran. 9:16 also takes layout top (graphic in the upper ~45%, speaker below)
